omar_infra: Quick hit overnight: eu2 dedicated pool showing repeated slab thrash between 02:00-03:30UTC. Allocator churn high, preemptions spike.
lena_sched: Which workloads?
omar_infra: Three short-burst tenants: tenant-batch-21, tenant-experiments, tenant-internal-fx. They fire many tiny RPCs, high PPS but low token volume. Burst credits burned through, pool backfill thrashes.
bryan_ops: That client-side test ramp looks like the immediate cause. Any deploys match the window?
antsy_dev:Yeah, I pushed an aggressive retry loop at 01:58UTC into staging by mistake; rolling back now. Sorry.
june_sre: Short term we should isolate the noisy tenants before the rollback completes. Proposal: create a fractional preemptible slice "burst-isolate-eu2-preemptible", soft-redirect 20% traffic there, then ramp.
lena_sched: Also add proxy-level token-bucket pacing per-tenant to blunt pps spikes. Longer term scheduler soft-quota to avoid immediate backfills.
billingbot: Projection: 24h of that preemptible slice ~ +$2.3k if converted to reserved; preemptible stays cheaper ~30% less.
bryan_ops: Let's keep it preemptible for now to contain cost. Tag tenants and set scheduler weight to 0.2 safe-mode.
omar_infra: commands to enact:
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-batch-21 routing=burst-isolate
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-experiments routing=burst-isolate
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-internal-fx routing=burst-isolate
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://scheduler.internal/api/v1/routes/weights -d '{"slice":"burst-isolate-eu2-preemptible","weight":0.2,"region":"eu2"}'
june_sre: opsbot, create INC and page SRE if preemptions >5/min for 10m.
opsbot: Incident created INC-2026-4720 'eu2 dedicated slab thrash' paging thresholds set.
omar_infra: Enabled eBPF per-host probe for ring occupancy and per-pod PPS.
lena_sched: Roll plan: 20% -> monitor 15m -> 50% -> full if preemption rate drops >50% and slab churn quiets. Rollback if not.
antsy_dev: rollback of test change in progress, ETA 5m.
bryan_ops: 02:20UTC update after 20% soft-redirect: preemption rate down 48%, ring occupancy down ~37%, slab alerts suppressed. Billing delta tracking enabled and assigned to my test budget for today.
june_sre: Good. Keep slice for 24h to watch for second-order effects; file RFC to add auto-soft-redirect when tenant PPS > X and burst-credit < Y.
lena_sched: Also add NIC-level eBPF shaping option at host to prevent IRQ storms next time.
omar_infra: Noted; will merge runbook into infra-playbooks and tag owners. Thanks all :thumbsup:
